name: Hefei Meyer Optoelectronic Technology Inc.
summary: Hefei Meyer Optoelectronic Technology Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of optoelectronic intelligent identification equipment in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Food Safety, Healthcare, and Renewable Resources. It offers channel and belt-type color sorters, x-ray inspection machine, quality analyzer, and digital and intelligent solutions for food and safety sector; dental CBCT, intraoral scanner, 2D panoramic machine, mobile CT, and spinal surgery robot for healthcare sector; and color, whole bottle, polymer, and aging and fluorescent flakes sorters for recycling sector.
